tips.title: Etakisi, ebasi
body: Vehicles are borrowed words: **etakisi**, **ebasi**, **emotoka** (car), **egaali** (bicycle), **boda boda**. **Epaaka** is the taxi park and **esiteegi** the stage.

tips.title: Kamon, atipet
body: **Kamon** is slowly, **atipet** quickly. **Abu adoŋ** is “I have arrived”. **Elosit ejok!** wishes a good journey.

culture.title: Roads from Soroti
body: Soroti sits on the road from Mbale to Lira, and a railway once ran through it. Today buses and taxis run to Kampala in about six hours.
